0022600135.text: The Indiana Pacers (2-2, 3rd in the Central and 1 game back, 8th in the East) host the Philadelphia 76ers (3-1, 2nd in the Atlantic, 4th in the East) in Indiana's fifth game of the season, with both teams coming off a loss. The Pacers are 0-1 at home and 2-1 on the road, while the 76ers are 2-1 at home and 1-0 on the road; the teams have not played yet in 2026-27, and Indiana lost all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 105-94 in Indianapolis on April 10, 2026. Indiana is without Ben Sheppard, Ivica Zubac, Johnny Furphy, T.J. McConnell and Tyrese Haliburton, and Aaron Nesmith, Andrew Nembhard and Obi Toppin are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti, Dominick Barlow, Jabari Walker and Tacko Fall.
